items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: And Alex Scott. We had a band there, bass player. We had a band there.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Kid Allen and Albert Martin, he's there too. You remember that Albedroom? Yeah. And Alex Scott. We had a band there, bass player. We had a band there. That's where, you know, left and went to Mexico, you know. And after that, when we come back, when I got a bass player, he left too. He used to wouldn't go nowhere but right up the country. He's kind of his daddy. Yeah, I remember. Tell me his son is almost as good as him now. Who, Red Allen? Huh? Who, Red Allen? Yeah. You don't know his son, eh? No, I don't…
Red Allen has been to Europe with Dude Ori.
